notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Turn employer research into a timely benefits conversation.
intro: A proposed outbound operations workbench for Basic Capital, connecting employer identity, benefits buying context and review timing to a reliable sales handoff.
queueIntro: Research the organization and the buying process. Employee balances, individual compensation and investment choices have no place in this account-research demo.
workbenchIntro: Check company context, ownership and sequence behavior before proposing outreach. A positive score does not determine retirement-plan suitability or eligibility.
firstBuild: A benefits-buyer brief that respects timing
firstBody: Combine employer and advisor context with a sourced review window, a practical administration question and a reply-aware handoff.

fields.label: Benefits or finance buying role confirmed
Review timing has a dated source
Advisor, PEO and existing seller checked
Reply and meeting stop rules validated

rules.title: Resolve the employer account
rules.next: Separate the employer, benefits advisor and PEO before assigning account ownership.

rules.title: Find the benefits decision owner
rules.next: Identify who can discuss the employer’s plan administration process. Do not use employee financial details.

rules.title: Confirm the review window
rules.next: A company growth signal does not establish a plan renewal date. Record unknown timing as a discovery question.

rules.title: Write the practical discovery question
rules.next: Ask about onboarding, administration or migration friction without promising returns or plan eligibility.

rules.title: Preserve the current relationship
rules.next: Check the advisor route and active sales owner before launching another sequence.

rules.title: Validate the sequence handoff
rules.next: A reply or booked conversation must stop the prospecting sequence and create an owned next task.

ready.title: Ready for benefits discovery review
ready.next: The seller can review the employer context and ask about administration needs. Plan terms, investment choices and eligibility remain outside this workflow.

experiments.name: Review-window relevance
experiments.hypothesis: A sourced timing signal helps the team start relevant conversations.
experiments.treatment: Verified review timing and administration question
experiments.primary: Held employer discovery per starting account
experiments.guardrail: Invented renewal dates and unsupported financial claims
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Reply-aware sequence handoff
experiments.hypothesis: An owned next task prevents duplicate outreach after a response.
experiments.treatment: Reply state synchronized with the receiving seller
experiments.primary: Replies with an accepted next task
experiments.guardrail: Messages sent after reply or stop request
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the employer sales motion
roadmap.body: Learn how employers, advisors and PEOs enter the pipeline. Agree on entity keys, timing sources and qualified discovery.
roadmap.measure: Duplicate accounts and accepted buyer briefs

roadmap.title: Build the research-to-reply path
roadmap.body: Pilot enrichment and a narrow outbound motion with visible failures and reply suppression.
roadmap.measure: Qualified replies and correct next-task ownership

roadmap.title: Improve conversion and enable the team
roadmap.body: Compare cohorts through held meetings. Document sequence maintenance and train sellers to correct research.
roadmap.measure: Held qualified discovery and repeat workflow use

metricsTitle: Follow the account from enrollment to a held conversation.
metricsIntro: Illustrative sequence states use unique employer accounts and a fixed 30-day window.

rows: Any human reply, including negative replies

metricsNotes: All counts are synthetic, not Basic Capital results.
Reply rate is not qualified pipeline. Keep negative replies, stop requests, scheduled meetings and held meetings distinct.
The demo provides no investment recommendation and makes no claims about retirement returns.
aiApplication: At Basic Capital, I would use coordinated research agents to assemble employer, advisor and benefits-review context, then validate timing and identity before a handoff. The loop would measure qualified conversations and corrections, with an owner approving outreach.
